cohort: The study included all newborns admitted to a tertiary NICU, excluding those who died or were discharged within 48 hours of admission.
finding: The overall incidence of HCAI was 17% (11.5/1,000 patient-days), with CVC/UC presence, urinary catheter presence, and gestational age (< 32 weeks) identified as significant independent risk factors for HCAI.
